name: terminal-motion-video
description: Artificial Insight terminal 모션 영상 (Remotion, 모의 데이터)

scripts.setup:browser: npx remotion browser ensure && sh scripts/setup-browser.sh
scripts.draft: remotion render src/index.ts Landscape out/draft_960x540.mp4 --scale=0.5 && remotion render src/index.ts Portrait out/draft_540x960.mp4 --scale=0.5
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Landscape out/video_1920x1080.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts Portrait out/video_1080x1920.mp4
